name: How long does a bathroom renovation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom renovation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom renovation depends on its complexity. A basic update, such as replacing a vanity and toilet, might take 1-2 weeks. A mid-range remodel involving new fixtures, tiling, and a refreshed layout usually takes 3-5 weeks. A complete gut and remodel, especially if it includes reconfiguring plumbing or electrical work, could extend to 6-8 weeks or more. These timelines factor in demolition, rough-in work, installation, and finishing touches. Unexpected issues can sometimes prolong the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom renovations can take 1-2 weeks for minor updates, 3-5 weeks for mid-range remodels, and 6-8+ weeks for complete renovations.
